params.title: Structuring under the limit
params.source: Typology; daily limits of Kazakhstan banks are not public, the limit is a parameter

hints: Victims pay in parts of ₸200,000, below the "new recipient" threshold of ₸300,000. Sum the amount to a new recipient over 24 hours instead of per single transfer.
Drop cards are older than 14 days (around 62), so the "young account" rule stays silent. Bought "warmed-up" cards get around it.
2 cards on one phone, the rule threshold is 3. The link is visible only in the graph.
Money moves on after ~50 min, while the victim notices the loss after 12 h on average.
The rules spot every chain, but too late: the account is frozen 60 min after the alert, and the money is already out by then. Real-time reaction is needed.
